args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (30+40+30 m), deck width 12.5 m, single-cell box (h=2 m, B_top=12.5 m, B_bot=6.5 m, t_top=0.25 m, t_bot=0.22 m, t_web=0.45 m). System = continuous_on_piers: the deck is a spine beam on flexible bearings atop two twin-column piers (Pier 1 h=14 m, Pier 2 h=8 m, D=1.6 m, C40) and two abutments.

Key decisions:
- Girder: A=6.532 m², I=3.564 m⁴ (section integration), Ec=34500 MPa (C50), γ=26.0 kN/m³, w=169.83 kN/m (self-weight only), m=17.31 t/m.
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge=1.2 MPa manufacturer value): Abutments 0 & 3 PTFE sliding (2 each, 400×500, 5×11 mm), Pier 1 PTFE sliding (2, 550×650, 6×11 mm), Pier 2 plain fixed (2, 600×700, 7×11 mm). Kv from JTG 3362-2018 §8.7 (3.61e6, 8.08e6, 8.97e6 kN/m); Kh=0 for sliding, Kh=13091 kN/m for the fixed Pier 2 bearing.
- Piers: twin columns combined (A=4.021 m², I=0.6434 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa), fixed at base.
- Live load: Class I, 3 design lanes, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/340/320 kN for spans 30/40/30 m.

Results: f1 = 3.434 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.2023 (JTG D60-2015 §4.3.2). Self-weight support reactions ≈ 1840/6646/6666/1832 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 8490/12616/8372 kN·m, support moments −21233/−21469 kN·m. Governing lane-load positive moment 9701 kN·m (mid-span 2), negative moment −7558 kN·m. Model passed all L1/L2/L3 checks.
